pgjdbc--pgjdbc--3089.title: Metaspace Memory leak: Thread.inheritedAccessControlContext

pgjdbc--pgjdbc--3089.reproduction_prerequisites: Tomcat 9.0.80 or reported JBoss, Java 17, affected pgjdbc 42.6.0/42.7.1, PostgreSQL 14, independent heap-root evidence; does not currently fit a 180-second first check.
